name: Strata Minerals Limited
summary: Strata Minerals Ltd. is an exploration firm established in Perth, Australia, on February 7, 2019, by Oliver Pierre Kreuzer. The company's operations encompass identifying, evaluating, and developing various mineral deposits. Its core focus is on valuable commodities such as gold, uranium, and rare earth elements. Among its key initiatives are the Penny South Gold, Elliot Lake Uranium, Biranup, and Dalwallinu projects.
